notes.title: Hotel Tales hit 30k Wishlists!
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44510355/1ab06bab765320233f06278a4d36b12ce8af6fc9.png[/img]

[h3]The streak of surprises continues: we’re thrilled to announce that Hotel Tales has surpassed 30,000 wishlists! A huge thanks to all of you for your support and attention to the project![/h3]

We’re already hard at work on the bonus packs and community items unlocked through wishlist milestones. We’ve got plenty of exciting ideas for these rewards, and we’re sure you share our enthusiasm.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44510355/d0eb1e024746cb43b54f1fba5f74f0563160eaba.png[/img]

This game is a very special project for us. It has gone through many stages: countless mechanics were designed, reworked, and ultimately left behind as we searched for the perfect fit. Guests came and went, checking out with promises to return, while new ones took their place. Now we’re close to release, and the final result is the fruit of tremendous effort put into realizing our vision of Hotel Tales.

We’re more confident than ever and racing toward launch. Very soon we’ll share the exact release date, and believe us — we’re just as eager as you are. So start booking your rooms and clearing your weekends now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3413800/Hotel_Tales/

notes.title: Hotel Tales Trailer and Femboy Futa House OST are here!
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44510355/dd2130d455a1ff6785c79536dcd8c608b5d8ae12.jpg[/img]

[h3]Missed our Hotel? We did too 😍[/h3]

All this time we weren’t just brewing coffee and eavesdropping on hallway gossip — we’ve been preparing something special for you. Something that instantly shows the kind of atmosphere ruling in our mysterious corner at the Crossroads of Worlds…

And yes, it’s a trailer! We captured all the most intriguing, mysterious, and alluring moments. Go watch it now on our Steam page!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3413800/Hotel_Tales/
[h3]Whose speakers are blasting through the whole dorm? Turn it up, because we’re listening to the Femboy Futa House soundtrack![/h3]

We know many of you have been asking for it, and finally, the Femboy Futa House music is now available for purchase on Steam. Grab it here and play it for your neighbors — they’ll definitely recognize those tunes 😉

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3963400/FEMBOY_FUTA_HOUSE__Soundtrack

notes.title: FEMBOY FUTA HOUSE IS RELEASING RIGHT NOW! 🔥
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45559776/2a2e94fa2ffbd6086da255385f85ae9047a0ccc4.png"][/img][/p][h2]🔥 FEMBOY FUTA HOUSE IS OUT NOW! 🔥[/h2][p]Today is a special day! We want to say thank you to everyone who added the game to their wishlist and waited for its release — your support is invaluable. We are happy to invite you to the most unforgettable magical adventure 😏 In honor of the release, there will be a 10% discount on the game and a 15% discount on the bundle 📣[/p][p]We are opening the doors to a magical world of vulgarity and debauchery![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3602290/FEMBOY_FUTA_HOUSE/"][/dynamiclink][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45559776/0610bf5b906b93e516996678897e2525e989e8d8.png"][/img][/p][h3]‼️ ATTENTION: DLC packs will be released alongside the game[/h3][p]🎶 [b]36 original soundtracks[/b] — music that will accompany you even outside the game.[/p][p]📖 8[b]0 pages of artbook[/b] — concepts and rare illustrations showing how our world was created.[/p][p]🖼️ [b]100 wallpapers[/b] — decorate your screen with your favourite characters and scenes.[/p][p]👗 12 [b]unique costumes[/b] — experiment with style and change the heroines' looks however you like.[/p][p]We made these sets for those who want to keep a piece of our game close to them — on their screen, in their headphones, and in their heart ❤️[/p][h2][b]💦 PLAY NOW ON STEAM! 💦[/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45559776/e2277760c9bf6815093cc8c6be1c551bee940c4d.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45559776/504cb81d96bdea9e3cb605f75b31bdc6ae33b3a7.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Living at the College of Magical Arts won't be easy, but your power will help you ✨[/b] After you fail your entrance exams, they send you to dorm 9 ¾ — home to the strangest and most extraordinary students on campus. But on your first night, something happens that changes everything: it turns out you have a rare gift — an Amplifier, the ability to amplify other people's magic. Now your life will be a whirlwind of attention, temptation and danger.[/p][p][/p][p]Feel the full weight of your burden. Will you have enough strength to help all the students discover their true power, or will they suck you dry? Meet the eccentric residents of dormitory number 9 ¾ and get to know them as well as you can…[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45559776/498149e3a3d4d09df7bc9f54e31b0c0ef8e9875a.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45559776/2ac77fa2f44a16323339d530512da6cfb9e0b08b.png"][/img][/p][h3]What awaits you?[/h3][p]💙 Follow the daily assignments (can something terrible happen if you don't do them?...)[/p][p]💙 A rich calendar of events - each day brings new challenges, unexpected encounters and plot twists.[/p][p]💙 Mini games and activities - study, take magic tests, participate in activities.[/p][p]💙 Explore the campus - secret rooms, unusual teachers and strange neighbors are waiting for you.[/p][p]💙 A unique talent – help (or hinder) others using your unique ability. Each decision changes your relationship with the characters and the future plot.[/p][p]💙 And of course, build romantic relationships. Flirt, make friends, fall in love, or make enemies. Your words and actions shape the story, from innocent friendly scenes to passionate and risky moments.[/p][p]Without your support, nothing of this would have been possible! So hurry up and start the game to dive into the world of FEMBOY FUTA HOUSE. You can find the DLC here 👇[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/58257/FEMBOY_FUTA_HOUSE__Deluxe_Edition"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: ONLY 1 DAY LEFT! GAME RELEASE SCHEDULE 🌍
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44510355/27b9ad62543f47336978072a56216116ce618121.png[/img]

[h1]You won't be able to hide from this release! FEMBOY FUTA HOUSE is coming out tomorrow, and we'll finally have a chance to share the results of our work with you! ❤️[/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3602290/FEMBOY_FUTA_HOUSE
We know that you, our beloved players, have been waiting for this for a long time. Many of you are from different corners of the world, so we have prepared a release map in different time zones for countries and regions. Explore it carefully and set your alarm clocks so you can be the first to break into dorm life and enjoy all the delights of the school of magic 🔥

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44510355/5197b693658bc04556ea57ce33527fda997c793d.png[/img]

[h3]⏰ When is the release time?[/h3]

Each region has its own launch time, and we don't want you to guess and figure it out yourself. That's why we've put everything together in a handy image — just find your region and remember the time!

[b]🔹 September 12[/b]
9 AM - Los Angeles

10 AM - Mexico 

11 AM - Houston

12 PM - New York

1 PM - San Paulo

3 PM - London

6 PM - Varsovia and Cape Town

7 PM - Moscow

8 PM - Dubai

9 PM - Almaty

11 PM - Bangkok and Krasnoyarsk

[b]🔹 September 13[/b]

1 AM - Seoul and Tokyo

2 AM  - Vladivostok

3 AM -  Hong Kong and Sydney

10 AM -  Anchorage

💖 Thank you for being with us all this time, for your support, reviews, and help in making the game better. Tomorrow we will finally meet you at FEMBOY FUTA HOUSE — and we promise this adventure will be unforgettable.

[b]In the meantime, get ready, add the game to your wishlists, and charge your magic wands, because tomorrow it all begins for real![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3602290/FEMBOY_FUTA_HOUSE/

notes.title: First GAMEPLAY trailer "FEMBOY FUTA HOUSE"
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44510355/d53042f6e44ca76792ea3fc5644d2d234750a84a.png[/img]

Missed us, sweetheart? We’re all eagerly staring at the words “coming soon,” waiting for replies from support like letters from a wizarding school. But! We really want to make you happy so the wait isn’t so painful.

We’ve released the gameplay trailer so you can sneak a peek inside this hot story — with one eye… or both at once! 😍🔥

[h3]⬇️ For the most impatient ones, watch right away ⬇️[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3602290/FEMBOY_FUTA_HOUSE

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44510355/b886b570bfd3f2f6e127e9d794b3a269d27455f8.png[/img]

We know some of you love to savor the process, so here’s what the trailer shows:
[list]
[*] Those very scenes where every glance, every movement, and every touch is filled with magic and seduction.
[*] An atmosphere of intrigue and flirtation that makes your heart beat faster.
[*] Mysteries of the academy and unexpected encounters.
[*] Atmospheric mini-games and other mechanics (all in the spirit of the story, of course)!
[/list]

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44510355/0f23dcd41be2a36541cb0f8fab3cfba96a93543b.jpg[/img]

We don't want to ignore the fact that FEMBOY FUTA HOUSE has reached 150k wishlistes! We thank you and promise to continue to please you with quality content ❤️

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44510355/caf877340bad015685bc4efe20a96963d5b6be07.png[/img]

[h3]Hurry up and watch the trailer — and add the game to your wishlist (you haven’t done that yet, have you? 😱)[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3602290/FEMBOY_FUTA_HOUSE/
